title: cerastium fontanum subsp. lucorum
intro: Cerastium fontanum subsp. lucorum, commonly known as Rock Cress or Alpine Sweet Rocket, is a flowering plant species within the carnation family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including anxiety and insomnia, due to its sedative and calming effects. The health benefits of Rock Cress include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help reduce stress and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Rock Cress include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as sedation and antispasmodic effects.
